segregation.statement: Individual narrative and TableS3 report de novo occurrence;main reports Sanger confirmation in probands/parents and24de novo of25disruptive cases,with EE9 the unknown-inheritance exception.
limitations: Reported parental confirmation supported;individual raw parental sequence traces are not published here for this assigned case,so no independent raw-read verification.

phase.statement: One heterozygous variant is reported;no second candidate allele or compound-heterozygous cis/trans question in this packet.

causal_confidence.statement: Recurrent de novo truncating variant in two distinct affected individuals supports authors' POGZ disease attribution and packet causal correspondence. Gene-level enrichment and predicted loss of function support plausibility.
limitations: Paper is gene-discovery association,not a formal variant-specific ACMG classification or direct assay of Arg674ValfsTer9. Fly row knockdown is not an assay of this human allele;White-Sutton/OMIM616364 later naming is not independently validated here. Penetrance estimate depends on assumed baseline prevalence.

25disruptive cases include10nonsense,12frameshift,1in-frame deletion and2splice variants;loose truncating wording should not erase the in-frame case. 24reportedde novo;EE9inheritance unknown.
Case/control enrichment OR35.8CI8.9-311.9 supports association,not deterministic penetrance. Reported65.9%penetranceCI36.4-89.8uses assumed5.12%baseline and is not a prospective follow-up proportion.

TableS6corrected significance threshold.008:feedingp.045is not significant after correction despite main significant wording;obesityp.07is a trend. Vision.000067,hyperactivity.004,microcephaly.003meet threshold. Sleep3/4versus1979/2757reportedp.100retained without recomputation.
Overallobesity12/25andASDsubgroup4/10have different denominators. No simultaneous feeding/obesity is not never either. Historical obesity and ascertainment differences constrain comparisons.
TableS3ASD DiseaseStudy labels represent ascertainment:EE12is an unaffected sibling permain/TableS4. Missense changes cannot all be treated as established pathogenic variants.

TablesS7/S8label values Bonferroni-corrected p-values yet include values above1;uncapped/unexplained scale retained,not silently normalized. Tissue expression and developmental associations do not establish tissue-specific clinical causation.
Dominant expression isoforms differ from longestNM_015100.3;isoform3skips112-189soEE6Gln180is outside that isoform. One cannot generalize every variant across every isoform.

Fly row shares limited overall identity and orthology withPOGZ/ZNF280. One knockdown line and whole-fly expression check do not establish variant-specific human neuronal mechanism. Initial jump response does not exclude all motor/sensory confounding.
TableS2success rate is fraction>20X in representative192-sample lane including laterQCfailures,not complete per-patient coverage or validation of packetGRCh38coordinates.
